breaking.change: DisplaySettings.frameCap, quality and powerPreference are read by name only: an index (frameCap: 1, quality: 2, powerPreference: 1) used to pick the variant at that position and is now refused with the field and the names, such as `settings.frameCap: expected a FrameCap name (auto, display, ...), got 1`.
breaking.fix: Pass the variant's name (frameCap: "fps30", quality: "high", powerPreference: "lowPower"), as og.render.display(world).settings answers them.

breaking.change: RenderTargetDesc.format is read by name only: format: 1 used to mean hdr and is now refused (`desc.format: expected a RenderTargetFormat name (...), got 1`).
CurveDesc.kind is read by name only: kind 0, 1 or 2 used to pick catmullRom, bezier or linear and is now refused (`desc.kind: expected a PathKind name (catmullRom, bezier, linear), got 0`).

TweenDesc, TweenFromDesc, TimelineTweenVars and TweenKeyframe are read whole by the generated types, `to` and `from` included: a lane list holding something other than a number is refused with its index (`desc.to[1]: expected a number, got "a"`) instead of a message without the path; a desc that is not an object is refused as `desc: expected an object`.
breaking.fix: Pass `to` and `from` as one number or a list of numbers.

breaking.change: ShapeGeometryDesc.shapes, ExtrudeGeometryDesc.shapes and SweepGeometryDesc.section are read by the generated types: a point whose x or y is not a number used to read as 0 and is now refused with its path (`desc.shapes[0].holes[0][2].y: expected a number, got "1"`). The uvRepeat of cylinderGeometry, coneGeometry, capsuleGeometry, torusGeometry, ringGeometry, circleGeometry and tubeGeometry is read the same way: a component that is not a number used to be 1 and is refused.
breaking.fix: Pass points as { x, y } numbers and uvRepeat as a Vector2 of numbers; og.Shape and og.Path2 are flattened by the TypeScript runtime as before.

breaking.change: GameDesc is read by the generated type: a field of the wrong type (a string tick, a scene that is not a string, a state without a name string) used to fall back to its default silently and now refuses the engine with the field's path, such as `og.game: desc.tick: expected a whole number from 0 to 4294967295, got "60"`.
breaking.fix: Pass each GameDesc field as the IDL types it.

added.summary: TweenDesc.to and from, TweenFromDesc.from, TimelineTweenVars.to and from and TweenKeyframe.to are typed as one number or a list (number | number[]), as the engine always read them.

uvRepeat is declared on CylinderGeometryDesc, ConeGeometryDesc, CapsuleGeometryDesc, TorusGeometryDesc, RingGeometryDesc, CircleGeometryDesc and TubeGeometryDesc (default 1 1), as the engine already applied it.
ShapeGeometryDesc.shapes and ExtrudeGeometryDesc.shapes take a list of ShapePoints (og.Shape.extractPoints) and SweepGeometryDesc.section a ShapePoints, as an og.Shape crosses to the engine.

MassTemplateDesc.pivot defaults to 0.5 0.5 and a size component of 0 is the kind's default (text and numbers 24, bars 80 × 8, icons 32, particles 8), as declared in the IDL; og.ui.previewViewport's Viewport.width and height default to 1280 and 720.
